reports.title: Broadridge Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Guidance
section:
FY’27 Guidance | Updates
Recurring revenue growth constant currency (Non-GAAP) | 6 - 8% | No Change
Adjusted Operating income margin (Non-GAAP) | ~21% | No Change
Adjusted Earnings per share growth (Non-GAAP) | 8 - 12% | No Change
Free cash flow conversion (Non-GAAP) | 100%+ | No Change
Closed sales | $290 - $330 million | No Change
Financial Results for First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 compared to First Quarter Fiscal Year 2026
•Total revenues increased 5% to $1,669 million from $1,589 million.
◦Recurring revenues increased $106 million, or 11%, to $1,083 million. Recurring revenue growth constant currency (Non-GAAP) was 11%, driven by 9pts from Organic growth.
◦Event-driven revenues decreased $46 million, or 41%, to $67 million, as lower mutual fund proxy revenues were partially offset by higher equity and other revenue.
◦Distribution revenues increased $20 million, or 4%, to $518 million, driven primarily by the postage rate increase of approximately $18 million.
•Operating income was $174 million, a decrease of $15 million, or 8%. Operating income margin decreased to 10.4%, compared to 11.9% for the prior year period.
◦Adjusted Operating income was $230 million, a decrease of $22 million, or 9%. Adjusted Operating income margin was 13.8% compared to 15.8% for the prior year period.
•Interest expense, net was $27 million, an increase of $3 million from $24 million.
•The effective tax rate was 13.6% compared to 22.4% in the prior year period. The decrease was primarily driven by an increase in total discrete tax benefits relative to pre-tax income.
•Net earnings decreased 43% to $95 million and Adjusted Net earnings were flat at $178 million.
